Container.Name: gemini-research-scraper
Container.Overview: Runs Gemini Deep Research on your behalf in a real browser: submits a query, approves the research plan, waits for completion, and saves the report as Markdown/HTML. HTTP API on port 8000 (interactive docs at /docs). One-time Google sign-in and progress-watching via the built-in noVNC web viewer on port 6080. Sign in once with: docker exec -it gemini-research-scraper gemini-research login

Config.Name: noVNC Port
Config.Description: Browser viewer for Google sign-in and watching research runs

Config.Name: Research timeout (s)
Config.Description: Max seconds to wait for a Deep Research run

Config.Name: Plan timeout (s)
Config.Description: Max seconds to wait for the research plan
